assignmentHtml.task:
全面调查 Zee Music Company 的 YouTube 频道。查明以下事项：

  1. 稳定频道 ID 及规范 URL。
  2. 运营方：Zee Entertainment Enterprises / Zee Music Company。企业隶属关系链。
  3. 频道创建日期，以及目前仍公开的最早上传视频。
  4. 运营地点及频道显示的国家。
  5. 使用的语言。
  6. 主要内容类别（音乐）。
  7. 内容供应模式：授权音乐曲库。
  8. 代表作品。提供直接来源 URL。
assignmentHtml.context: 根据 Communitrics 于 2026 年 9 月 2 日的快照，Zee Music Company 排名第 16 名，历史累计观看量约为 91B（910 亿）次。需要可核实的事实，并附来源链接。
assignmentHtml.expected_output: 一份关于 Zee Music Company 的结构化资料，包含全部要求的字段，每个字段均附来源 URL。

answerHtml:
Zee Music Company YouTube Channel — Comprehensive Dossier

(1) STABLE CHANNEL ID AND CANONICAL URL
• Channel ID: UCFFbwnve3yF62-tVXkTyHqg
• Canonical URL: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCFFbwnve3yF62-tVXkTyHqg
• Alternate handles that redirect to canonical: https://www.youtube.com/user/zeemusiccompany ; https://www.youtube.com/@zeemusiccompany
Sources: YouTube channel page metadata; Wikipedia "List of most-viewed YouTube channels" table.

(2) OPERATOR AND CORPORATE CHAIN
• Operator: Zee Music Company, a wholly-owned subsidiary of Zee Entertainment Enterprises Limited (ZEEL), headquartered in Mumbai, India.
• Corporate chain: Zee Entertainment Enterprises Limited (parent) → Zee Music Company (subsidiary/music-publishing division).
• Key people: Punit Goenka (CEO, ZEEL); Sujal Parekh (CBO).
• Predecessor: Zee Records (music-publishing division operating since 1994; rebranded as ZMC in March 2014).
Sources: Wikipedia infobox (Parent: Zee Entertainment Enterprises); Wikitubia/Fandom.

(3) CHANNEL CREATION DATE AND EARLIEST STILL-PUBLIC UPLOAD
• First upload date: March 12, 2014 (channel active since 2014 per YouTube metadata and third-party trackers).
• Earliest still-public upload identified: "Sar Utha Ke | Hawaa Hawaai Full Video ft. Javed Ali" — uploaded September 9, 2014 (231K+ views). This is the earliest dated video found on the channel; no earlier dated public uploads were located.
Sources: ThoughtLeaders.io (first upload March 12, 2014); YouTube video page for PyWjU9OG2Ak (upload date Sep 9, 2014).

(4) OPERATING LOCATION AND DISPLAYED COUNTRY
• Headquarters: Mumbai, Maharashtra, India.
• Displayed country: India (🇮🇳 flag shown on Communitrics profile).
Sources: Wikipedia infobox (Headquarters: Mumbai, India); Communitrics profile.

(5) LANGUAGES
• Primary language: Hindi.
• Catalog languages (per Wikipedia): Hindi, Marathi, Punjabi, Bengali, Bhojpuri, Gujarati, Tamil, Telugu, Kannada, Malayalam, plus additional regional languages (up to ~22 languages across the network).
Sources: Wikipedia "Catalogue" section; Wikipedia "List of most-viewed YouTube channels" (Primary language: Hindi).

(6) PRIMARY CONTENT CATEGORY
• Category: Music.
Sources: Wikipedia "List of most-viewed YouTube channels" (Content category: Music); Communitrics (Music · Entertainment).

(7) CONTENT SUPPLY MODEL
• Licensed music catalog model: ZMC acquires, publishes, licenses, and distributes film soundtracks, regional-cinema recordings, devotional music, and independent singles from film producers, studios, and independent artists.
• Library size: 20,000+ songs (per ZEEL FY2025–26 earnings update).
• Distribution via YouTube, Spotify, Apple Music, Amazon Music, JioSaavn; YouTube network spans 176M+ subscribers and 217B+ cumulative views across all ZMC sub-channels.
• Over 14,000 music videos posted on the flagship channel since 2014.
Sources: Wikipedia (founding mission and catalogue description); Musically article (14,000+ videos); ZEEL FY2025–26 earnings cited in Wikipedia.

(8) REPRESENTATIVE WORKS (flagship channel, verified view counts)
• "Mile Ho Tum – Reprise Version" | Fever (Neha Kakkar/Tony Kakkar) — 1,405,135,665 views; uploaded Jul 27, 2016.
• "Kala Chashma 🕶️" | Baar Baar Dekho (Sidharth Malhotra/Katrina Kaif/Badshah) — 1,201,496,290 views; uploaded Jul 26, 2016.
• "Phir Bhi Tumko Chaahunga 💖" | Half Girlfriend (Arijit Singh/Shashaa Tirupati) — 1,262,606,998 views; uploaded Jul 6, 2017.
• "Teri Mitti" | Kesari (Akshay Kumar/B Praak) — 467,460,125 views; uploaded Mar 15, 2019.
• Additional hits cited by press: "Taras," "Uyi Amma."
Sources: Direct YouTube video pages (N2-HsIYd0Go, k4yXQkG2s1E, _iktURk0X-A, wF_B_aagLfI); Digital Music News (June 2025).

ADDITIONAL CONTEXT (from orchestrator note)
• Per Communitrics snapshot (~Sep 2, 2026): ranked #12 globally with 123M subscribers and ~91B lifetime views. Confirmed on Communitrics profile page.
• Milestone: Received YouTube's Red Diamond Creator Award in June 2025 upon crossing 100M subscribers (only second music label after T-Series).
• Note: Wikipedia's "most-viewed channels" table lists ZMC at 88.5B views (ranked #15 by that source's date), while Communitrics shows 91B (#12) as of Sept 2, 2026 — consistent growth trajectory.
